description: This is a SwiftUI view implementation defining the LoginView for a mobile app. It manages user login UI, including email/password input, password visibility toggle, and session control actions.

classes.name: LoginView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for user login, handling input fields, password visibility, and session management actions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Performs the login operation asynchronously using provided email and password, handling loading state and error messages.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI view hierarchy for the login interface.

methods.name: isLoginDisabled
methods.description: Computed property to determine if login button should be disabled based on input state and submission status.
